name: B10-0082/2025 (Renew) – Systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the systematic repression of human rights in Iran, notably the cases of Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi, and the taking of EU citizens as hostages
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking for action. It asks Iran to cancel all death sentences and free political prisoners, naming Pakhshan Azizi and Wrisha Moradi. It asks the European Union to help families of detained EU citizens, warn people against travelling to Iran, and put more Iranian officials under sanctions. It also asks the Council to label the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps a terrorist organisation.

- Iran is asked to cancel death sentences and free prisoners; nothing changes automatically.
- EU citizens held in Iran would get more support; travel to Iran discouraged.
- EU sanctions could grow; the Council decides on the terrorist label.
